headline: Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf Fuel Heavy Frontline Clashes
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has erupted into the war's most volatile sector, logging ten base transitions over the past two hours around Frostmarch, Crow's Nest, and Shattered Advance while absorbing over thirty-three hundred combined casualties. Stlican Shelf remains fiercely contested with five fresh structural actions in the two-hour frame, leaving one strategic position reduced to no-man's-land amid heavy fighting at Vulpine Watch and The Pale House. Along the western approaches, Farranac Coast and Fisherman's Row each registered two base shifts over the last two hours, centered on The Bone Haft and Eidolo. In contrast, base transfers have halted in Mooring County and Godcrofts, though Mooring County continues to sustain over thirteen hundred casualties in two hours. Callahan's Passage has seen a sharp surge in bloodshed, racking up nearly twenty-four hundred casualties in two hours without immediate territorial swaps, while fighting across Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands has markedly cooled.
